name: phoenix-economics

scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build && npx --yes -p node@22 -p wrangler@4.147.0 wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=phoenixeconomics --branch=main
scripts.deploy:worker: cd cloudflare && npx --yes -p node@22 -p wrangler@4.147.0 wrangler deploy
scripts.paper: node paper/compute.mjs && python3 paper/stability.py && python3 paper/tables.py && python3 paper/figures.py

author: Samuel Akosa Onyejekwe
description: Live implementation of Phoenix Economics Solutions: a network differential-equation framework for real-time surplus absorption, liquidity routing and inflation early warning.
